title: Lead Specialist / Manager - US Health Benefits Analytics
description:
Marsh is seeking candidates for the following position based in the GGN / Noida office
  
  
This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
**What can you expect?**
Power User is a subject matter expert in Health Benefits analytics who owns the end-to-end analytical workflow for a portfolio of client accounts. This role goes beyond running reports — the Senior Analyst is expected to independently develop analytical narratives, design custom analyses, mentor junior analysts, and act as the primary analytics partner to consulting leads.
  
  
The Senior Analyst is the person in the room who the consultant turns to when a client asks a complex data question. Deep platform knowledge, strong healthcare domain understanding, and the ability to connect data to strategy are the defining characteristics of this role
  
  
**We will count on you for:**
**Analytics & Reporting**

* Run standard and custom reports within the analytics platform across medical, pharmacy, and eligibility data
* Build PMPM, trend, and benchmark analyses for assigned client accounts
* Support production of Executive Summary, Financial Overview, and High-Cost Claimant reports
* Perform condition-level drill-downs to identify cost drivers across inpatient, outpatient, professional, and pharmacy categories
* Conduct utilization vs. unit cost decomposition to differentiate pricing inefficiency from volume-driven spend

**Data Interpretation & Insight Development**

* Translate raw analytics output into structured narratives for consultant review
* Identify population-level trends — chronic condition prevalence, high-cost claimant patterns, specialty pharmacy utilization
* Flag anomalies in data outputs and escalate for data quality review where needed
* Support benchmarking analysis — compare client metrics against the broader book of business by industry, region, and employer size

**Client Support & Collaboration**

* Prepare data packages and slide-ready analytics outputs for consultant use in client presentations
* Respond to ad hoc data requests from consulting team with accuracy and within agreed turnaround times
* Collaborate with the Data Operations team to understand data scope, coverage dates, and known limitations for each account
* Maintain account-level documentation including data source inventory, report run logs, and analysis notes

**What you need to have:**
**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel — pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data validation, charting
* Ability to work with large, structured datasets and identify patterns across multiple data dimensions
* Data warehouse like Artemis, Meratives, HDMS, Truven etc.– preferred
* Basic SQL or data querying ability preferred — not mandatory
* Familiarity with analytics or BI platforms (experience with health analytics tools is an advantage)

**Domain Knowledge**

* Strong command of US health benefits landscape — self-insured vs. fully-insured, stop-loss, TPA/PBM ecosystem
* Basic understanding of claims data structure — medical and pharmacy claim fields, adjudication logic, allowed vs. billed vs. paid amounts
* Awareness of key metrics key metrics — PMPM, PEPM, trend rate, utilization vs. unit cost decomposition, episode cost benchmarking
* Awareness of common employer cost intervention strategies — point solutions, COE programs, disease management, Rx formulary strategy

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Analytical ownership — takes full responsibility for accuracy and completeness of outputs
* Proactive communication — does not wait to be asked, flags issues and opportunities early
* Consultative thinking — connects analytical findings to business implications and action
* Coaching mindset — invests in the development of junior team members

**What makes you stand out?**

* Adaptable communicator, facilitator, influencer and problem solver
* High attention to detail
* Good relationship skills, Proven ability to work on own initiative as well as in a team
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize time effectively
* undefined

**Why join our team?**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: FSRC-R and CT-RCT-PYTHON and SQL-STAFF
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – RCT**
**Staff – Python & Advanced SQL**
**Staff – Software Engineering**
**Experience: Strictly 2+ years**
**Eligibility requirement:**
Candidates must have 2–4 years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on cloud experience. Freshers, candidates with less than 2 years of experience, and candidates without cloud experience are not eligible for this role.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Join a financial crime technology team building data-driven solutions for global financial services clients. This role combines hands-on Python engineering, advanced SQL development, and practical exposure to Financial Crime Compliance processes. You will work with business, compliance, data, and engineering stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a hands-on software engineer with strong Python and advanced SQL skills and relevant Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. The successful candidate will develop and support data-intensive applications, analytical workflows, and rule-based solutions used in customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, investigations, and regulatory reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain Python applications, services, utilities, and data-processing workflows.
* Write complex, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, profiling, and investigation use cases.
* Work with large financial datasets, including customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data.
* Translate Financial Crime Compliance requirements into technical designs, data rules, scenarios, and reusable components.
* Support KYC and AML workflows such as customer onboarding, customer risk rating, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and periodic review.
* Contribute to Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud solutions, including rule implementation, threshold logic, alert generation, data validation, and issue analysis.
* Develop APIs, batch jobs, automation scripts, and integration components using Python.
* Perform unit testing, code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis, and production support.
* Collaborate with compliance SMEs, business analysts, data engineers, QA teams, and client stakeholders in Agile delivery teams.
* Follow secure coding, version-control, documentation, and deployment practices.

**Primary Skills – Must Have**

* Python: Strong hands-on programming experience, including data structures, functions, object-oriented programming, exception handling, modules, logging, testing, and performance-conscious coding.
* Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, query optimization, stored procedures, and data reconciliation.
* Databases: Practical experience with at least one relational database such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Data engineering: Experience processing structured data using Python libraries such as pandas and integrating with databases, files, or APIs.
* APIs and services: Working knowledge of REST APIs and Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Engineering practices: Git, unit testing, code review, debugging, documentation, and CI/CD fundamentals.
* Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Candidates should have practical experience developing, deploying, or supporting data-driven applications or services in a cloud environment.

**Good to have**

* Experience with PySpark or distributed data processing.
* Familiarity with orchestration or ETL tools such as Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
* Experience with data visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Understanding of model or rule performance measures, threshold tuning, false-positive reduction, and data lineage.
* Exposure to Agile delivery tools and practices, including Jira or Azure DevOps.

**Financial Crime domain knowledge**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, and remediation.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators, typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, and regulatory reporting concepts.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario or rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, back-testing, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlist concepts, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.

**Experience And Education**

* Experience: Strictly 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or technology delivery.
* Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with less than 2 years of relevant experience will not be considered.
* Cloud experience: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP is mandatory.
* Domain experience: Relevant delivery experience in KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, or Fraud is good to have.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Production-quality Python and SQL that is accurate, maintainable, secure, and efficient.
* Clear understanding of the business purpose and regulatory context behind the solution being built.
* Strong ownership of assigned deliverables, defects, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Ability to explain technical findings and data issues clearly to both engineering and compliance stakeholders.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

As part of the Quantitative Banking Book (QBB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk management within the banking portfolio. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk estimation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with lending activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across banks, including large domestic and global financial institutions.

* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Monitor progress, manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes

* Flexibility to work across projects involving model audits, validation and development activities

* Should have hands on experience in data preparation, manipulation and consolidation
* Expertise in Stress Testing models and/or PD/LGD/EAD models
* Solid grounding in statistics and econometrics, especially logistic regression, linear regression, fractional response, decision tree
* Strong documentation skills. Required to be adept in quickly grasping key details and summarizing them in a presentation or document
* Strong knowledge in regulatory modelling (ECB/PRA/HKMA/Regulators) with model development/validation experience
* Strong technical skills, highly proficient in Advanced Python (Pandas, Numpy, ScikitLearn, Object Oriented Programming, Parallel Processing), SAS (SAS Certified Preferred), SQL, R, excel
* Should be able to take initiative and work independently with minimal supervision, if required
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation (experience in AI/ML will be preferred)
* Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Good to have knowledge in Machine Learning models and its applications
* Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.
* Previous project management experience

* Postgraduate (master’s in accounting, finance, economics, statistics or a related field) with at least 3 years of related work experience
* Regulatory knowledge in IFRS 9, IRB, CCAR, CECL, Stress Testing, DFAST
* Professional certifications (FRM, SCR, RAI, CFA, PRM are a plus)
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions

title: Principal Consultant - Project Controls
description:
**Job Description**
WSP India is seeking to onboard a highly experienced and strategic Project Management Expert to support the US T&I business line. The role will be responsible for leading project setup, cost control, scheduling, documentation, forecasting, reporting, subcontract coordination, and project performance monitoring across infrastructure and engineering projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Project Setup, Cost Control & Financial Analysis
  
  

* Provide strategic coordination for project setup and cost control activities, including the Pricing Tool, Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), Project Opening Form (POF), cost coding, and baseline project information.
* Direct and oversee monthly financial analysis, Earned Value Tool, and review cost performance, variances, trends, risks, and forecast accuracy.
* Collaborate with project managers, finance teams, and stakeholders to drive monthly project reviews, forecaster updates, and effective project controls in multiple regions across the US.

Document Management & Project Plans
  
  

* Lead and control key project documentation, including the Project Management Plan, Risk Management Plan, Project Safety Plan, Quality Plan, and PMO governance-related records.
* Ensure project records are accurate, complete, current, properly filed, and aligned with internal governance, quality, safety, risk, and delivery requirements.
* Promote document control best practices and compliance with established project management and WSP’s standards across project portfolios.

Schedule Management
  
  

* Direct the development, review and oversight of project schedules, activity plans, milestones, baselines, and critical paths using approved tools such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or Smartsheet.
* Provide strategic guidance to project teams and stakeholders on schedule risk management, progress performance, and delivery assurance, while supporting risk mitigation planning and schedule optimization.

Subconsultant / Subcontract Management
  
  

* Provide oversight and strategic direction for the preparation, submission, tracking, and administration of subcontracts and subconsultant documentation in coordination with project management, procurement, commercial, and finance teams.
* Monitor deliverables, approvals, pending actions, standard terms, and related documentation to support timely subcontract execution and contractual compliance.
* Guide project teams in managing contractual and administrative requirements while supporting effective engagement with subconsultants and subcontract stakeholders.

Project Reporting, Forecasting & Invoicing Support
  
  

* Provide strategic direction to team members for preparing and maintaining project controls reports, dashboards, monthly updates, forecasts, and performance summaries covering cost, schedule, risk, progress, and Earned Value analysis.
* Support project manager and PMO team by providing insightful analysis of project performance data to facilitate informed decision-making and effective project governance.
* Oversee and facilitate progress reports for invoicing by coordinating with project managers, finance teams, and delivery stakeholders to validate progress, billing inputs, supporting information, and project performance data.

Key Competencies / Skills:
  
  

* Strong understanding of project controls, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, progress reporting, documentation, and Earned Value Management (EVM).
* Proficient in Advanced Excel and MS Office Suite. Comprehensive knowledge of Power BI, Oracle ERP, Horizon/NetSuite, or similar financial systems is preferred.
* Expert in Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and Smartsheet.
* Strong analytical, coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Self-motivated, proactive, adaptable, and open to new challenges.
* Adopts “Best for WSP” approach to daily activities.
* Flexible with work timings to support US-based project teams across time zones.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related discipline. Master’s degree in construction management or project management is mandatory.
* 12+ years of hands-on experience in project controls, scheduling, cost control, reporting, documentation, financial analysis, or project management support within engineering, infrastructure, or professional services environments.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:

GNV Commodities Pvt Ltd is a pan-India distributor of pet products, focused on bringing high-quality global pet care solutions to pets across India. The company combines strong domain expertise with end-to-end in-house capabilities, managing operations from port to pet. Its portfolio of products and services is guided by the principle of using the same items for its own companion animals. This philosophy reflects a strong commitment to quality, safety, and trust. Team members join a mission-driven organization that values responsible pet care and long-term partnerships with customers and suppliers.

**Department:**

E-commerce / Digital Marketing

**Experience:**

2–5 Years

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**Location:**

Noida / Delhi NCR

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a
**performance-driven Amazon Ads Account Manager**

to manage and scale advertising for our premium pet-care brands on Amazon.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in
**Amazon PPC, campaign strategy, keyword research, bid optimisation, budget management, and performance analysis**

, with a clear focus on
**sales growth, ROAS, ACOS, and profitability**

.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Amazon Advertising & PPC – Primary Responsibility**

* Plan, create, manage, and optimise Amazon PPC campaigns across multiple brands and SKUs.
* Manage
  **Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display**

  , and other available Amazon advertising formats.
* Develop campaign strategies based on brand objectives, SKU priorities, margins, and sales targets.
* Conduct detailed
  **keyword research**

  and build keyword/product targeting strategies.
* Manage
  **Auto, Manual, Broad, Phrase, Exact, Product and Category targeting**

  campaigns.
* Continuously optimise
  **CPC, bids, budgets, keywords, placements, and targeting**

  .
* Monitor and improve
  **ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPC, impressions, clicks, and attributed sales**

  .
* Identify high-performing keywords and ASINs and scale them aggressively.
* Identify wasteful spend, irrelevant search terms, and underperforming campaigns and take corrective action.
* Conduct regular
  **Search Term Reports and Search Query Performance**

  analysis.
* Manage negative keywords and optimize search-term targeting.
* Develop strategies for
  **new product launches**

  , including initial visibility and ranking campaigns.
* Build campaigns to improve both
  **organic ranking and paid visibility**

  .
* Allocate advertising budgets across brands, categories, and SKUs based on performance.
* Monitor daily ad spend and ensure budgets are utilised efficiently.
* Prepare and implement strategies during
  **Prime Day, Great Indian Festival, and other Amazon events**

  .
* Conduct competitor advertising and keyword analysis to identify new growth opportunities.

**Performance Analysis & Reporting**

* Track daily, weekly, and monthly advertising performance.
* Prepare detailed PPC performance reports and dashboards.
* Analyse:
* ROAS
* ACOS
* TACOS
* CTR
* CPC
* Conversion Rate
* Impressions
* Clicks
* Ad Sales
* Ad Spend
* Organic Sales
* Total Sales
* Compare advertising performance against sales and profitability targets.
* Identify performance gaps and provide clear action plans.
* Present campaign performance and recommendations to management.

**Amazon Business & Catalogue Support**

* Work closely with the e-commerce team to ensure advertised ASINs have strong content, pricing, ratings, reviews, and inventory availability.
* Identify listing/content issues that may impact advertising conversion.
* Coordinate with the content team for
  **A+ Content, images, titles, bullets, and Brand Store improvements**

  .
* Monitor competitor pricing, promotions, rankings, and advertising activity.
* Support new SKU launches and promotional campaigns.

**Key KPIs**

* Amazon Ad Sales
* Overall Amazon Sales Growth
* ROAS improvement
* ACOS/TACOS optimisation
* Advertising ROI
* Conversion Rate
* Organic ranking growth
* Keyword ranking
* Reduction in wasted ad spend
* New customer acquisition
* Brand and SKU-wise sales growth
* Achievement of monthly advertising and sales targets

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Amazon PPC/Advertising**

  .
* Excellent understanding of Amazon Ads campaign structures and targeting.
* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets knowledge.
* Ability to work with large SKU and keyword portfolios.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics and profitability.
* Ability to independently manage advertising budgets.
* Strong attention to detail and numerical skills.
* Performance-oriented mindset with a focus on
  **sales and ROI**

  .

**Preferred Experience**

* 2–5 years of experience in Amazon PPC / Amazon Ads.
* Experience managing multiple brands and large advertising budgets.
* Experience in
  **FMCG, pet care, food, beauty, or consumer products**

  preferred.
* Amazon Ads certification will be an added advantage.
* Experience with Seller Central and Vendor Central is preferred.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is someone who
**thinks beyond simply running campaigns**

. They should be able to analyse data, identify what is driving sales, control unnecessary spend, scale winning campaigns, and continuously improve Amazon advertising profitability.

**The primary objective of this role is to make Amazon Ads a strong and scalable sales engine for GNV Commodities.**

title: Applied Scientist II, Cross Border Science and Analytics
description:
**Description**
The Cross-Border (XB) Science & Analytics team is at the heart of Amazon's international marketplace expansion, powering science-driven solutions that enable customers across 20+ countries to discover and purchase products seamlessly across borders. Our work directly impacts millions in annualized business value through ML models, algorithms, and data-driven systems that solve some of Amazon's most complex cross-border challenges.
  
  
We are a lean, high-impact team of scientists working across various programs spanning search ranking, demand forecasting, pricing optimization, product recommendations, language understanding, and generative AI. We partner closely with product, engineering, and business teams across Amazon's global retail organization to take science from ideation to production at scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for a passionate and technically strong Applied Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and algorithms that directly improve the cross-border shopping experience for millions of Amazon customers worldwide. You will work on challenging, ambiguous problems—from improving search relevance across languages to building ML-powered pricing and recommendation systems—with significant autonomy and end-to-end ownership.
  
  
This is a hands-on, high-visibility role. You will publish your research internally and externally, collaborate with world-class scientists and engineers, and see your work go live across Amazon's global marketplaces.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Research & Experimentation
  
  
Analyze large-scale datasets to identify patterns, formulate hypotheses, and design experiments
  
  
Develop and iterate on ML models (deep learning, NLP, ranking, causal inference) to improve cross-border product discovery, relevance, and conversion
  
  
Design and run A/B experiments on live traffic to measure model impact against business and customer metrics
  
  
Building & Shipping
  
  
Write production-quality code (Python, Java/Scala) and work with SDEs to deploy models into real-time and batch inference pipelines
  
  
Build end-to-end ML pipelines—from data ingestion and feature engineering to training, evaluation, and online serving
  
  
Own model monitoring, performance debugging, and iterative improvements post-launch
  
  
Collaboration & Communication
  
  
Participate in weekly science syncs, design reviews, and cross-functional standups with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders
  
  
Translate business problems into well-defined science problems, and communicate results and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences
  
  
Contribute to technical documentation—architecture wikis, experiment write-ups, and model cards
  
  
Growth & Community
  
  
Present at internal ML paper reading sessions and science forums
  
  
Stay current with state-of-the-art research (NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL, KDD) and bring new ideas to the team
  
  
Mentor junior scientists and interns; participate in hiring interviews and debriefs
  
  
Publish findings in top-tier venues and file patents where applicable
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development

title: Fraud Risk & Risk Analytics
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a data-driven Risk Management professional with 5–7 years of experience in Fraud Risk, Operational Risk and Risk Analytics within the Fintech, Payments or Digital Banking ecosystem.

The role will focus on identifying and mitigating fraud and operational risks through data analytics, transaction monitoring, risk dashboards and robust control frameworks. The incumbent will work closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations and Compliance teams to strengthen risk governance across payment products and merchant ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Fraud Risk & Risk Analytics

* Identify, analyse and monitor fraud patterns, suspicious transactions and emerging risk trends across payment products.
* Develop data-driven monitoring mechanisms to identify anomalies, transaction irregularities and potential fraud exposure.
* Build and maintain fraud and operational risk dashboards using SQL, Python and BI tools.
* Perform data extraction, querying and analysis to generate actionable risk insights.
* Define and track Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), fraud metrics, operational losses and risk thresholds.
* Conduct root cause analysis of fraud incidents and recommend preventive controls.

2. Operational & Payments Risk Management

* Assess risks across merchant onboarding, KYC, transaction processing, payment operations and customer servicing.
* Strengthen controls around merchant onboarding, PAN validation, MCC classification and transaction monitoring.
* Monitor payment risk exposure and ensure adherence to RBI regulations and payment network guidelines.
* Drive Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) and identify control gaps.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to implement risk mitigation measures.

3. Outsourcing & Third-Party Risk Management

* Conduct risk assessments and due diligence of third-party service providers.
* Monitor vendor performance, SLA adherence and control effectiveness.
* Support periodic risk reviews and ensure compliance with applicable RBI Outsourcing Guidelines.
* Partner with Information Security and Compliance teams on vendor risk assessments.

4. Risk Reporting & Governance

* Develop automated dashboards and periodic risk reports for management review.
* Translate complex datasets into meaningful business insights and recommendations.
* Drive risk analytics initiatives through SQL queries, Python-based analysis and dashboarding.
* Maintain risk policies, SOPs and governance documentation.
* Support internal audits, external audits and regulatory inspections.

Desired Candidate Profile

**Experience & Industry**

* 5–7 years of experience in Fraud Risk, Risk Analytics, Operational Risk or Payments Risk.
* Experience in Fintech, Digital Payments, Payment Aggregators, Payment Gateways or Banking is essential.
* Prior experience with digital-first financial platforms and payment ecosystems preferred.

**Technical & Analytical Skills**

* Strong hands-on expertise in SQL, including writing complex queries for data extraction and analysis.
* Working knowledge of Python for data analysis, automation and risk analytics.
* Advanced Google Sheets / MS Excel skills.
* Experience with dashboarding and visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar platforms.
* Ability to analyse large datasets, identify patterns and derive actionable insights.

**Domain Expertise**

* Strong understanding of Fraud Risk, Transaction Monitoring and Payment Risk.
* Knowledge of RBI Outsourcing Guidelines and PA Master Directions.
* Familiarity with KYC, merchant onboarding, PAN validation and MCC classification.
* Understanding of RCSA, KRIs, operational loss management and control testing.

**Education**

* MBA / Postgraduate qualification in Finance, Risk Management, Analytics or related disciplines preferred.
* Graduates from Tier 1 and Tier 2 institutes preferred.

**Target Designations:**
Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager (AM/DM)

title: Implementation Consultant
description:
**About the Company -**

Algoworks is an award-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience

transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and

India. We bring together a global team of engineers, architects, designers, researchers and

operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable

results.

For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the

Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful

business outcomes. Our work combines human-centered design, engineering excellence

and AI-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision.

Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams

approach problem-solving and continuous improvement.

At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across

geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and

collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment

where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the

intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong

global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

**Role Overview-**

The Implementation Consultant (IC) turns client requirements into a working, tested and

documented Gotransverse configuration with speed and precision. The IC works alongside

the Executive Sponsor, Project Manager, Business Analyst, Solution Architect and QA to

translate business requirements into platform configuration, support testing and

reconciliation, and ensure successful implementation and handover.

The role combines billing domain knowledge, hands-on platform skills, analytical thinking

and client-facing communication to deliver accurate and reliable configurations.

**Key Responsibilities-**

1. Discovery & Requirements

• Run working sessions with clients and translate contract terms and business

scenarios into configurable requirements.

• Ask clarifying questions to understand the business need behind client requests.

• Challenge unclear requirements and recommend best practices.

• Ensure requirements are traceable to corresponding build elements.

• Understand design specifications to determine implementation next steps.

2. Platform Configuration & Build

• Configure the catalog, charges, lookup tables, custom fields, SRIDs, mediation

streams and integrations.

• Translate documented requirements into accurate Gotransverse configurations.

• Validate configuration changes and check work before handing it off.

• Ensure configuration and runbook documentation remain current as the build

changes.

3. Testing & Reconciliation

• Write and execute test cases.

• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and regression testing after changes.

• Reconcile system output against source data and client expectations.

• Investigate and explain variances between system output and source data.

• Triage defects and distinguish data issues, configuration gaps, new requirements

and product bugs.

4. Demo Preparation & Execution

• Prepare and conduct client demonstrations.

• Tailor demo scripts to the audience.

• Stage clean demo data and dry-run end-to-end scenarios.

• Capture feedback, document follow-ups and communicate next steps.

5. Cutover, Go-Live & Handover

• Support cutover, go-live and hypercare activities.

• Contribute to migration, parallel-run and rollback planning.

• Maintain relevant configuration and runbook documentation.

• Ensure a clean transition to support and Customer Success teams.

6. Client & Internal Communication

• Provide clear and organized updates to clients and internal teams.

• Adjust communication for executive and technical audiences.

• Escalate risks and issues early.

• Work closely with the Executive Sponsor, Project Manager, Business Analyst, Solution Architect and QA.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies**

**Core Technical Skills-**

• Strong SQL skills to query and validate data independently and reconcile counts and totals.

• Understanding of JSON and APIs, including building payloads, authentication, error handling and pagination.

• Data analysis skills, including Excel pivots, lookups, identifying outliers and explaining variances.

• Ability to work with configuration data and validate system outputs against source

data.

**Delivery & Implementation -**

• Understanding of requirements traceability and the ability to map requirements to

configuration elements.

• Ability to write test cases, execute UAT and regression testing, and reconcile outputs with source data.

• Understanding of defect triage and the ability to distinguish data issues, configuration gaps, new requirements and product bugs.

• Familiarity with cutover, go-live, migration, parallel runs, rollback planning and

hypercare.

**Consulting & Client Engagement -**

• Ability to conduct discovery sessions and clarify business requirements.

• Ability to recommend best practices rather than only implementing requested

changes.

• Strong demo preparation and execution skills.

• Ability to communicate clearly with both executive and technical stakeholders.

**Must-Have Skills -**

• SQL and data validation.

• Data analytics and reconciliation.

• Understanding of JSON and APIs.

• Requirements analysis and traceability.

• Testing, UAT and regression testing.

• Configuration validation and defect triage.

• Client communication and stakeholder management.

• Strong attention to detail and precise execution.

**Good to Have Skills -**

• Experience with billing platforms or subscription management systems.

• Familiarity with Gotransverse.

• Experience with mediation streams and integrations.

• Exposure to cutover, migration, parallel runs and hypercare.

**Desired Attributes -**

• Fast, detailed and precise in execution.

• Checks own work before handing it off.

• Organized and clear in client and internal communication.

• Able to adapt communication for executives and technical teams.

• Curious and comfortable challenging unclear requirements.

• Commercially and operationally practical.

• Focused on recommending best practices.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: Revenue Operation Analyst
description:
**About Us**
At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.
  
  
And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.
  
  
Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/
  
  
Job Details
  
  
****The Role****
We are seeking a Revenue Operations Analyst to own both sides of Salesforce: the integrity of the data going in and the reporting coming out. You will build the reports and dashboards that Sales, Business Development, Finance, and leadership run on, and keep the underlying data accurate so those numbers are trusted. This is a hands-on analyst role — we expect you to answer the question behind the request, not just deliver the number. The position reports to the Senior Manager of Revenue Operations and works daily with Marketing, Business Development, Sales, and Finance.
  
  
****The Work -****
****Reporting & Analytics****

* Builds and maintains Salesforce reports, custom reports, and dashboards for frontline reps, managers, and executives
* Owns recurring funnel reporting — Lead to MQL to SAL to SQL conversion, speed-to-lead, stage progression, and pipeline creation — with documented, consistent metric definitions
* Analyzes Business Development activity (outreach, response times, meeting conversion) and marketing-sourced lead quality — surface trends, outliers, and recommended actions
* Builds analysis beyond native Salesforce reporting using Excel models, SQL queries, and BI dashboards
* Reconciles data across Salesforce, HubSpot, and the sales engagement stack to ensure one source of truth
* Turns ad hoc questions from Sales, Marketing, and Finance leadership into repeatable reporting with documented methodology
* Calculates monthly commissions and commission statements from Salesforce data
* Performs cohort and trend analysis (retention/expansion by segment, YoY, seasonality) and detect anomalies using statistical methods
* Evaluates data quality before analysis — identify root causes vs. symptoms and drive ambiguous metric definitions to precise, documented terms
* Builds decision frameworks with trade-offs, run scenario/what-if modeling, and redirect stakeholders when the wrong analysis is requested (core skills, ask right questions)
* Breaks down complex problems into the right data sources and metrics; apply statistical fundamentals (mean, median, percentiles, standard deviation, correlation) with documented methodology

****Salesforce Data & Automation****

* Maintain accurate, consistent records across accounts, contacts, leads, and opportunities — including data cleansing, deduplication, and field standardization
* Monitor and enforce data quality standards; build reporting that makes data quality gaps visible
* Own lead import, routing, and assignment for marketing-sourced and third-party contacts to business development reps and sellers
* Design and maintain Salesforce Flows and declarative automation for lead management, data quality, and reporting
* Integrate data across sales technologies (HubSpot, Groove, Koncert, Seismic) for a holistic view of engagement and pipeline effectiveness
* Understand object relationships, data model architecture, and the security model (profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules) and how they affect report visibility
* Implement validation rules and duplicate management to prevent bad data at entry; use enrichment tools to fill data gaps
* Manage change (sandbox deployments, change sets) and use audit fields for change tracking and troubleshooting

****Go-to-Market Support****

* Build targeted audience lists for outbound campaigns and event follow-up, aligned to account segmentation, buying personas, and intent data
* Document report definitions, data logic, and recurring processes so the work is repeatable and not person-dependent

**Qualifications**

* 4 - 5+ years in relevant revenue operations, sales operations, or business/data analysis supporting a commercial team
* Hands-on Salesforce expertise — reports, custom report types, dashboards, data imports, list views, and Flow Builder or comparable declarative automation
* Demonstrated analytical ability — able to structure a question, choose the right data, and explain what the result means, not just produce the output
* Experience using AI-assisted tools for data analysis (SOQL/SQL generation, Python scripts, Excel formulas) and data exploration (summarize datasets, identify patterns, generate hypotheses)
* Write effective AI prompts with context and constraints; verify generated output and recognize AI limitations and hallucinations
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets — Power Query, Power Pivot, advanced lookups, string manipulation, and data modeling
* Working SQL skills — able to query a database or warehouse
* Experience building and maintaining dashboards in a BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, or similar)
* Clear written and verbal English and strong asynchronous communication habits — this role works with a US-based team and is expected to document its own work
* Salesforce Administrator certification is a plus
* Experience with HubSpot, Groove, Koncert, or Seismic is a plus

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/
  
  
**Benefits**
At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.
  
  
With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Game mathematician I
description:
At Aristocrat, we are passionate about crafting world-class gaming experiences that entertain millions of players globally. As a Game Mathematician I, you will play a crucial role in developing the future of our games. Our mission is to bring happiness to life through the power of play, and we seek ambitious, innovative individuals for our inclusive and collaborative team. This is an outstanding opportunity to work with dedicated professionals and contribute to high-quality games that compete globally. If you are motivated by challenge and thrive in a dynamic environment, this role is perfect for you!
  
  
What You'll Do

* Analyze game requirements in collaboration with business collaborators to ensure flawless execution
* Develop intricate math models for Class 3 and Class 2 slot games, calculating the probability of game events and documenting game mathematics using Excel-based templates
* Write simulations to verify math accuracy and compliance with jurisdictional requirements
* Apply knowledge of C programming (or equivalent) to validate game mathematics and simulate gameplay
* Review math test plans and results to ensure game compliance with target market standards
* Build innovative new game concepts that captivate our audience
* Ensure high performance in game quality and timely market delivery

What We're Looking For

* Minimum 2+ years of industry experience in a Math or Statistics related role
* Basic programming skills in C/C++ under Windows/Linux operating systems
* Strong skills in probability theory and its applications
* Proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
* Good understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
* Educational background in Mathematics or Statistics (MSc or equivalent experience, or M. Tech.)

*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*
**Compensation Philosophy**
We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
  
  
Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.
  
  
Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Data Analyst
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Data Analyst / BI Developer who is exceptional in Tableau and even stronger in advanced SQL and data understanding. The role will own the complete analytics lifecycle—from understanding a business question and validating source data to building optimized SQL datasets and publishing reliable, decision-ready Tableau dashboards.

The successful candidate must be able to work independently with large, complex datasets, identify data-quality issues, explain the business meaning behind numbers, and convert analysis into clear, actionable insights. Strong Python development capability is required. DBMS experience and/or React knowledge will be an added advantage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Partner with business and functional teams to understand processes, KPIs, reporting requirements, decision points, and data definitions.

• Design, develop, publish, and maintain enterprise-grade Tableau dashboards, reports, and reusable data sources.

• Build efficient and reliable SQL queries for complex analysis, reconciliation, reporting, and data preparation.

• Investigate data discrepancies by tracing data from source systems through transformations to final dashboards.

• Define data grain, joins, business rules, metric logic, filters, and exception-handling rules before visualization.

• Optimize Tableau workbooks, extracts, live connections, calculations, and underlying SQL for performance and scalability.

• Develop Python-based utilities and workflows for data extraction, transformation, validation, automation, API integration, and recurring analysis.

• Perform exploratory analysis, identify trends and anomalies, and communicate findings in simple business language.

• Create documentation covering metric definitions, data lineage, dashboard logic, refresh schedules, assumptions, and known limitations.

• Apply appropriate access controls, row-level security, testing, version control, and deployment practices.

• Support users after release, troubleshoot production issues, and continuously improve dashboards based on usage and feedback.

• Coach stakeholders and team members on effective dashboard use and sound interpretation of data.

MANDATORY TECHNICAL SKILLS

1. Exceptional Tableau expertise

• Deep hands-on knowledge of Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server/Cloud.

• Expert-level capability in calculated fields, Level of Detail (LOD) expressions, table calculations, parameters, sets, context filters, dashboard actions, data blending/relationships, and reusable data sources.

• Strong understanding of extracts versus live connections, refresh strategy, row-level security, publishing, permissions, subscriptions, and dashboard governance.

• Proven ability to create clean, intuitive, executive-ready dashboards without compromising analytical depth.

• Strong Tableau performance-tuning skills, including reducing query load, optimizing calculations, improving workbook design, and using performance diagnostics.

2. Expert-level advanced SQL

• Excellent command of complex joins, CTEs, subqueries, window functions, conditional aggregation, set operations, pivots/unpivots, date logic, and advanced analytical queries.

• Ability to write accurate SQL for large datasets while handling duplicates, nulls, changing master data, incomplete records, and different levels of granularity.

• Strong understanding of query execution plans, indexing, partitioning, views/materialized views, and performance optimization.

• Ability to independently reconcile results across source tables and prove the correctness of reported numbers.

• Sound knowledge of relational database concepts, normalization, dimensional modelling, fact/dimension design, and data marts.

3. Strong data and business understanding

• Ability to translate an unclear business requirement into precise questions, definitions, source mappings, and acceptance criteria.

• Strong understanding of data quality, data lineage, master data, transaction data, historical versus current-state reporting, and source-of-truth controls.

• Ability to distinguish correlation from causation, validate assumptions, identify anomalies, and explain why a metric changed—not only what changed.

4. Python development

• Strong hands-on Python skills for data processing and automation.

• Experience with pandas, NumPy, database connectivity, REST APIs, file processing, logging, exception handling, and reusable modular code.

• Ability to build and maintain ETL/ELT utilities, validation scripts, scheduled workflows, and analytical prototypes.

• Familiarity with Git, code review, testing, and maintainable development practices.

PREFERRED / ADDED ADVANTAGE

• DBMS expertise, including schema design, indexing, EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE, functions, views, materialized views, and database performance tuning.

• React knowledge for building lightweight analytical applications, integrating dashboards, or creating custom data-driven user interfaces.

• Exposure to data warehouses, cloud data platforms, orchestration tools, APIs, and modern data pipelines.

• Experience working with operational, sales, finance, supply-chain, or manufacturing data will be useful.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrable experience delivering production Tableau solutions and writing complex SQL in a business environment.

• A strong portfolio or practical examples of dashboards, SQL problem-solving, performance tuning, and data reconciliation will be preferred.

title: Risk Analytics - AI Governance - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Risk Consulting – AI Governance - Senior**
**The opportunity: your next adventure awaits.**
Are you a tech-savvy professional with a risk mindset who is passionate about building a better working world through the power of people, technology, and innovation? We have an incredible opportunity for you to join our dynamic Enterprise Risk team and make a real impact in the rapidly evolving world we live in. Within Risk Consulting, you will focus in the areas of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Risk Management and Governance which would cover AI Auditing techniques, AI Risk and Controls, Pre-Implementation reviews, Data Privacy reviews, AI application security and BCP review of AI Applications.
  
  
This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you’ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Your key responsibilities will include:**

* Consistently deliver quality client services. Drive high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget. Monitor progress manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.
* Foster relationships with client personnel to analyse, evaluate, and enhance information systems to develop and improve security at procedural and technology levels.
* Use knowledge of the current IT environment, AI models and applications and industry trends to identify engagement and client service issues and communicate this information to the engagement team and client management through written correspondence and verbal presentations. Stay abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business.
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Demonstrate ability to quickly assimilate to new knowledge.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* You will leverage your proven track record of technology plus business process internal audit experience and strong personal skills, to effectively deliver quality results in the assessment, design, and support implementation of AI Risk solutions

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree and approximately 3-6 years of related work experience
* At least 2-4 years of working experience in Internal audit, risk, compliance for both business and IT audits, with a strong understands of AI related risks and governance practices.

+ IT Pre-implementation and Post implementation reviews
+ Model Risk Management
+ AI Compliance and regulatory assessments – Risk and Controls assessment of AI/ML applications in line with AI related regulations and frameworks
+ Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify security findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified on applications and infrastructure. Develop risk control matrix in line with EU AI Act, COBIT, ISO, NIST and ITIL Best Practice and recommendations.
+ Control Monitoring / Testing - Understanding of Cyber and compliance standards like PCI, ISO27001, perform test the design and operational effectiveness of the cyber controls.
+ Defect / Gap Identification: Identify the confidentiality, integrity and the availability related deficiencies in the client environment and evaluate against industry standards.
+ IT Infrastructure and Architecture risk assessments including data quality and data migration reviews, data privacy reviews, OS DB reviews etc.
+ Control Automation – Identify controls automation opportunities through analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
+ Excellent communication, documentation and report writing skills.

* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI Ethics and AI Assurance
* Ability to identify process level risk arising from the use of AI and develop mitigation strategies.
* Good to have relevant industry certifications such as AIGP, ISO 42001, CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Who We Are**
Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. **#UatInsurity**

**Insurity’s Next**
**Business Analyst II**
Insurity is looking for a Business Analyst II to join our India office and help deliver customer-focused software solutions. This role independently analyzes and documents increasingly complex business, functional, and non-functional requirements, partners with stakeholders through testing and training, and contributes to system design and configuration. This role specializes in analyzing and documenting requirements for insurance forms, translating regulatory and business needs into clear, testable solutions.The ideal candidate brings strong business analysis and US P&C Insurance experience, communicates clearly, and can serve as a subject matter expert while mentoring other team members.
  
  
**What Our Business Analyst**
**II Will Do**

* Analyze Forms requirements and support the definition, documentation, and testing of form-related changes in partnership with product, development, and regulatory stakeholders.

* Perform and support testing and training activities.
* Perform and coordinate work estimation.
* Support automation and quality improvements.
* Participate in system design and configuration activities.

* Provide mentorship to team members and help strengthen business analysis practices through collaboration and knowledge sharing.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Recommended: 3 years of business analysis experience and one year of industry experience, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Recommended: Bachelor’s degree in a related field; equivalent work experience may be considered.
* US P&C Insurance industry experience, or completion of required Insurity Academy courses within three months.
* Experience engaging with technical and business stakeholders in Agile and/or Waterfall environments
* Strong understanding of business analysis practices, including process analysis, design, and management; change management; meeting facilitation and the ability to present information clearly and articulately.
* Proficient analytical and critical-thinking skills, written and oral communication, time management, prioritization, organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Self-starter who thrives in a collaborative and evolving environment
* Strong understanding of writing SQL queries and database design concepts
* Nice to have: Related insurance certifications, such as CPCU, CBAP, AINS or a line-of-business-specific certification.
* Ability to complete related insurance certification(s) within two years, as applicable.

enterprise reporting, analytics, and data insights across the organization. This is a senior,
  
  
hands-on role requiring deep technical expertise across the Microsoft data and BI stack,
  
  
strong business acumen, and the ability to operate with minimal hand-holding. The ideal
  
  
candidate will act as a bridge between business leadership and technical teams, translating

ingestion through executive dashboards.

leadership.

effort.

records and SCDs.

title: Principal GIS Consultant - GeoAI & Spatial Intelligence
description:
**Job Description**
As a Principal Geospatial Consultant with WSP, you'll support multi-disciplinary projects within the Geospatial team as part of the Transformation & Digital Insights service line, with a particular focus on supporting complex infrastructure and land projects. Reporting to an Associate / Associate Director and collaborating with GIS, Geospatial, Data Science Data Engineering, AI and Technical Specialist teams, you'll help the team grow both personally and technically to maintain top-tier client service. As a Principal Geospatial Consultant specialising in GeoAI and Spatial Intelligence, you will sit at the intersection of GIS engineering and applied artificial intelligence—designing, building, and deploying advanced geospatial solutions across infrastructure, utilities, land and property, water, and environmental sectors. This is a hands-on technical role. You will develop production-grade Python workflows, design and optimise spatial data pipelines, and integrate AI and machine learning frameworks into GIS environments to deliver scalable, data-driven insights. You will act as a subject matter expert for both internal teams and clients, translating emerging GeoAI capabilities into practical, real-world applications. You will play a key role in shaping our GeoAI approach within the practice—defining methodologies, driving innovation, and embedding automation and intelligence across project delivery. Alongside this, you will mentor and support junior colleagues, fostering technical excellence and helping to grow our geospatial capability in line with market demand. Join WSP at a time of growth and transformation, where you will play a key role in delivering geospatial solutions across major infrastructure schemes, supporting projects across sectors such as land management, property and planning, energy and transportation.
  
  
**What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…**
Strong technical skills in Esri platforms, scripting (preferably Python), FME, SQL, data management, and data science workflows along with a proactive, resilient mindset and exceptional problem-solving abilities are required. The ideal candidate will have a customer focused mindset to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop GeoAI solutions — including object detection, feature extraction, change detection, and predictive spatial modelling — using both Esri tools and open-source AI frameworks.
* Write production-grade Python toolboxes, automation scripts, and spatial data pipelines for ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, and SDE environments.
* Integrate deep learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch or TensorFlow) and ML libraries (such as scikit-learn or Hugging Face) into geospatial workflows to solve clientspecific problems at scale.
* Lead technical delivery on GeoAI project workstreams across utilities network analysis, land ownership and registry data, and water / environmental constraint modelling.
* Collaborating with project managers and sector leads to scope, estimate, and quality-assure GIS and GeoAI deliverables.
* Provide technical assurance and peer review of GeoAI and GIS outputs to ensure quality, robustness, and compliance with agreed standards.
* Produce clear technical documentation and methodology reports, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor and support junior GIS analysts and developers, reviewing code and promoting best practices in spatial data science.
* Stay current with Esri platform releases, emerging GeoAI tools, and relevant academic or industry research, contributing to internal capability development.

**Essentials**
- you will need skills and experience in these areas to be successful in the role:
  
  

* Strong professional experience in GIS, with a clear focus on Python development and automation.
* Strong Python skills: ArcPy, ArcGIS API for Python, geopandas, shapely, rasterio, GDAL.
* Practical experience applying AI/ML to geospatial problems (e.g. object detection, image classification, feature extraction, or spatial prediction).
* Working knowledge of at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
* Experience with ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, and File or SDE geodatabases.
* Ability to communicate technical outputs clearly to non-GIS audiences.

**Desirable skills:**

* Experience with Esri ArcGIS Image Analyst or ArcGIS GeoAI tools.
* Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers or ONNX model deployment.
* Exposure to cloud GIS environments: Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Knowledge of FME for geospatial data transformation workflows.
* Familiarity with remote sensing data: satellite imagery, LiDAR, SAR, or aerial photography.
* Exposure to Power BI or analytics dashboards.

**Qualifications**
Degree in Engineering, GIS, Geography, Computer Science, or a closely related discipline.
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in GIS / GeoAI / spatial technologies
* Experience working with international clients (preferably UK-based projects)

title: Data Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
**Data Analyst – Supply Chain**

**About the company**

Raphe mPhibr Pvt. Ltd is India’s largest R&D-driven UAV manufacturer, revolutionizing aerospace with indigenously developed, cutting-edge drone technology. Our UAVs have flown over 1 million kilometres across diverse terrains and weather conditions.

With 900+ talented professionals trained at premier institutions like MIT, Georgia Tech, IITs, and NITs and state-of-the-art research and manufacturing facilities, we design and build almost every component of our UAVs in-house. Our expertise spans Aerodynamics, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Software, and AI, enabling us to create comprehensive and customized end-to-end solutions.

Recognized for our rapid growth and inclusive culture, we were recently named LinkedIn's Top 10 Startups 2024 and honoured with the FICCI Women's Empowerment Award. Beyond work, we foster a collaborative, fun, and inclusive workplace, supported by unique events and thoughtful policies that reflect our commitment to our people We innovate for a better society!

We innovate for a better society!

**Do you want?**

* The opportunity to work alongside highly innovative and technical minds?
* A competitive salary based on your skills?
* To turn supply chain data into decisions that keep the right material, in the right quantity, at the right time?

**Job Brief:**

We are looking for a
**Data Analyst - Supply Chain**
to turn Raphe’s supply chain data into numbers that drive decisions. You will maintain and analyse the Material Delivery Plan, model demand, stock and lead times, and catch shortages before they hinder research or production. Working with our planners, buyers and supplier quality team, you will use data to show what is working. This role is built for a mathematician who wants to apply that rigour to real world cases and deadlines.

Are you ready to be part of a dynamic, fast-growing team? If yes, then let’s solve the real problems and innovate newer possibilities. Sounds interesting? Come, join us on this incredible journey!

Don’t just dream about what’s next – build it!

**Essential Skills:**

* Strong foundation in mathematics and statistics: probability, distributions, regression and basic optimisation.
* Strong Excel: lookups, pivots and clean data handling across large item lists.
* Ability to track and maintain planned orders with quantities and need dates.
* Ability to calculate and maintain safety stock and reorder points from demand and lead-time data.
* Ability to build a shortage report and rank shortages by production impact.
* Discipline with master data: correct lead times, units of measure, order multiples and BOM revisions.
* Clear communication of numbers to non-technical teams through simple tables and charts.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Demand and supply planning: balancing demand, supply and capacity across a horizon, including scenario plans.
* Continuous improvement: data-driven retrospective analysis to improve processes.
* Programming for data analysis in Python, R or SQL.
* Dashboarding tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Interest in aerospace, defence or drone (UAS) technology is a plus.

**As Data Analyst - Supply Chain, you will:**

* Maintain and update the Material Delivery Plan with the right material, in the right quantity, at the right time.
* Track planned orders against need dates and flag gaps early.
* Calculate safety stock and reorder points, and monitor stock and excess.
* Run the shortage report, rank shortages by production impact and support recovery with purchasing and suppliers.
* Keep master data accurate: lead times, units of measure, order multiples and BOM revisions.
* Build demand, supply and capacity scenarios to support planning decisions.
* Analyse supply chain KPIs such as lead-time trends, on-time delivery, stock turns and supplier defect rates.
* Build dashboards and reports that give leadership a clear view of material status.
* Document methods, models and findings so the next person starts faster.

**Qualification and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or a related quantitative field.
* 0–2 years of experience; freshers are welcome to apply.
* Internship, project or coursework in data analysis, statistics or operations research is a plus.

title: Business Analyst- CEO office
description:
**Role overview**

The Business Analyst in the CEO Office will be the analytical engine behind strategic projects for Havells' leadership. The role suits an early-career consultant (1 to 2 years at a top-tier firm) who is strong at data analysis, structured problem solving and synthesis, and wants to move from advising clients to shaping decisions inside one of India's leading electrical and consumer durables companies.

Working with the CEO Office team and senior leadership, the analyst will build fact bases, model scenarios, frame problems and turn complex analysis into crisp recommendations across Havells' businesses (cables and wires, switchgear, lighting, fans, appliances and Lloyd consumer durables).

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Data analysis and fact-base building**

* Build and maintain analytical models in Excel to size markets, track business performance and test hypotheses.
* Clean, structure and analyse large internal datasets (sales, channel, pricing, cost, dealer and electrician data) to surface insights.
* Monitor key business KPIs and build leadership dashboards that flag trends, gaps and exceptions early.
* Benchmark Havells against domestic and global peers on growth, margins, channel and operating metrics.

**2. Conceptual problem solving**

* Break down ambiguous leadership questions into structured issue trees and hypotheses, then design the analysis to answer them.
* Support operational improvement projects by mapping processes, quantifying inefficiencies and estimating impact of fixes.
* Contribute to cost optimisation, pricing, portfolio and channel strategy work across business units.

**3. Synthesis and communication**

* Convert analysis into clear storylines and consulting-grade presentations for the CEO and business heads.
* Draft concise memos, board and review notes, and one-page summaries with a clear "so what".
* Prepare business cases for new products, investments and initiatives for leadership approval.

**4. Strategic initiatives, partnerships and GTM**

* Conduct market, competitor and customer research to support partnership, collaboration and inorganic opportunity screening.
* Support go-to-market strategy and new product launches with segmentation, pricing analysis and post-launch performance tracking.
* Assist in preparing proposals, MoUs and evaluation frameworks alongside senior team members.

**5. Project and stakeholder support**

* Coordinate with cross-functional teams (sales, marketing, product, finance, supply chain) to gather data and drive workstreams to closure.
* Track project milestones, action items and outcomes from leadership reviews.
* Support digital transformation and automation initiatives, including use of AI and analytics tools in decision making.

**Education**

* B.Tech / BE from a reputed engineering institute, followed by an MBA (Not necessary)
* Strong academic record with evidence of quantitative aptitude.

**Experience**

* 1 to 2 years of experience in a management consulting firm. Experience gained after undergraduation (pre-MBA) and after post-graduation (post-MBA) are both relevant, and can be combined.
* Track record of delivering analysis-heavy workstreams on strategy, operations, commercial excellence, cost or due diligence engagements.
* Exposure to manufacturing, industrials, consumer durables, FMEG or B2B2C businesses is a plus.
