title: Business Analyst – Accounts Payable (AP) Domain Expert || 15 year || Noida || Only Immediate Joiner
description:
**Job Descriptions**

**Role:**
Business Analyst – Accounts Payable (AP) Domain Expert

**Work Location:**
Noida / Gurgaon

**Experience Required:**
15+ Year

**Role:**
Business Analyst – Accounts Payable (AP Domain Expert)

**Primary Skills:**
Salesforce, Business Analysis (BA)

**Secondary Skills:**
Accounts Payable (AP) Domain Expertise, Touchless Invoice Processing, Agentic AI in Accounts Payable

**Location:**
Noida / Gurgaon

**Experience:**
15+ Years

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with strong expertise in the Accounts Payable (AP) domain, Salesforce, and business process transformation. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of end-to-end invoice processing workflows, touchless invoice processing rules, and the application of Agentic AI in Accounts Payable.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, finance teams, product owners, and technology teams to analyze business requirements, define process improvements, and drive automation initiatives across the AP lifecycle. Experience in Salesforce-based solutions, intelligent automation, and AI-driven finance operations will be highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Analysis & Salesforce

* Engage with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements, functional requirements, and business process specifications.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops, requirement elicitation sessions, gap analysis, and impact assessments.
* Translate business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, and process workflows.
* Leverage Salesforce capabilities to support business process management, workflow automation, case management, and integration with enterprise finance systems.
* Collaborate with Salesforce developers, solution architects, QA teams, and product owners to ensure successful solution delivery.
* Manage requirements traceability, backlog prioritization, UAT planning, defect resolution, and business sign-off.
* Ensure alignment between business objectives, technical solutions, and operational requirements.

2. Accounts Payable Domain Expertise

* Demonstrate strong knowledge of the end-to-end Accounts Payable lifecycle, including:
* Invoice receipt and capture.
* Invoice data extraction and validation.
* Purchase order (PO) and non-PO invoice processing.
* Two-way and three-way matching.
* Duplicate invoice detection.
* Exception handling and discrepancy resolution.
* Approval workflows and payment readiness.
* ERP integration, vendor master validation, and payment processing.
* Understand AP controls, compliance requirements, audit trails, segregation of duties, and exception management.
* Identify process bottlenecks and recommend improvements to reduce invoice processing time, cost, and manual intervention.
* Define business rules, validation logic, exception categories, and escalation mechanisms for invoice processing.

3. Touchless Invoice Processing

* Define and document touchless invoice processing rules to maximize straight-through processing (STP).
* Identify the business conditions required for invoices to be processed without manual intervention.
* Establish rules for PO matching, tolerance thresholds, tax validation, vendor validation, duplicate checks, coding, and approval routing.
* Define exception scenarios and business rules for routing invoices to the appropriate teams.
* Analyze touchless processing performance using KPIs such as:
* Touchless processing rate.
* First-pass match rate.
* Invoice exception rate.
* Invoice cycle time.
* Cost per invoice.
* Manual intervention rate.
* Work with automation, data, and technology teams to continuously improve AP process efficiency and accuracy.

4. Agentic AI in Accounts Payable

* Identify and evaluate use cases for applying Agentic AI across the Accounts Payable lifecycle.
* Define business requirements for AI agents supporting invoice intake, data validation, PO matching, exception investigation, and workflow orchestration.
* Identify opportunities for AI-driven decision support, autonomous task execution, and intelligent exception resolution.
* Define agent workflows, business rules, decision boundaries, escalation paths, and human-in-the-loop approval mechanisms.
* Establish controls to ensure traceability, explainability, accuracy, compliance, and appropriate authorization for AI-driven actions.
* Collaborate with AI/ML, automation, and engineering teams to translate AP business needs into scalable AI-enabled solutions.
* Define success metrics to measure the impact of Agentic AI on touchless processing, productivity, accuracy, and operational cost.

5. Stakeholder Management & Delivery

* Act as the primary liaison between finance stakeholders, operations, business leadership, and technology teams.
* Facilitate solution design discussions and validate proposed solutions against business needs.
* Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, solution demonstrations, UAT, and implementation activities.
* Prepare process maps, business requirement documents (BRDs), functional requirement documents (FRDs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and support change management and business adoption.

Required Skills & Qualifications

title: Senior Lead Marketing Manager - AI & Campaign Analytics Transformation
description:
The Marketing Manager will be a key member of the Campaign Analytics team, responsible for transforming marketing intelligence through AI, automation, advanced analytics, and performance insights. This role will drive data\-driven decision\-making by proactively monitoring business performance, identifying trends, uncovering risks and opportunities, and delivering actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands\-on experience in AI\-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8–12 Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Noida
   

  

**Shift:** 
 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**AI \& Analytics Transformation**
* Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
* Design and deploy AI\-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
* Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
* Establish best practices and governance for AI\-assisted analytics and insight generation.


**Strategic Business Insights**
* Analyze end\-to\-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
* Conduct in\-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
* Perform root\-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision\-making.
* Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
* Deliver data\-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.


**Performance Intelligence \& Forecasting**
* Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
* Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
* Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
* Track week\-over\-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.


**Automated Monitoring \& Anomaly Detection**
* Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.
* Detect emerging risks, unusual activity, and performance anomalies across campaigns, channels, website traffic, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and spend effectiveness.
* Assess business impact and distinguish between genuine performance issues, growth opportunities, and measurement discrepancies.
* Lead diagnostic and root\-cause investigations to identify the primary factors influencing performance outcomes.


**Optimization \& Executive Decision Support**
* Translate analytical findings into prioritized recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
* Identify opportunities to optimize campaign investments, resource allocation, channel strategies, and marketing execution.
* Proactively surface risks that may impact target achievement and highlight emerging opportunities for growth.
* Provide executive\-ready performance insights, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to support leadership decision\-making.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Analytics, Campaign Performance, or related analytical functions.
* Strong expertise in data analysis, performance measurement, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
* Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies within analytics environments.
* Proficiency with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
* Advanced SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Python or other analytical programming tools is highly desirable.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience supporting B2B marketing, demand generation, funnel analytics, and revenue performance initiatives is preferred.

title: Senior Analyst - Customer Journey Mapping
description:
Join us as a "Senior Analyst \- Customer Journey Mapping, where you'll build analytical tools to generate insight, recognise patterns and predict behaviour, and deliver content direct to users of information products. You will work with technical teams, architects, designers, and administrators to overcome technical challenges and to make it happen. This role is responsible for supporting the design and delivery of end\-to\-end customer and colleague journey transformations across Barclays UK (BUK) Business Banking front \& back\-office operations and will contribute significantly to shaping Target Operating Models (TOMs) and eliminating process debt.
   

  

 The role is also responsible for ensuring the consistency and quality of process maps developed by journey mapping analysts, and for translating those maps into a business\-relevant narrative for wider stakeholder engagement providing a cohesive storyline of customer and colleague pain points, while identifying opportunities to deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, operational efficiency, and control effectiveness, in alignment with Barclays’ transformation strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Journey \& Process Design**
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable, and digitally enabled journeys.
* Support high\-impact process optimization engagements that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and risk management
* Oversee Customer Journey mapping analyst’s output (timeliness and overall quality)
* Provide support to Analysts by providing best\-practice guidance and conceptual support on journey mapping techniques, as required
* Integrate multiple journey variant maps to provide a consolidated view of related customer journeys
* Coordinate with stakeholders to obtain relevant data references that support effective journey visualisation
* Develop insightful visualizations that highlight customer pain points and identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve journey efficiency.


**Tooling \& Visualization**
* Use Figma, and Blueworks Live to map current and future state journeys.
* Maintain a centralised journey register and ensure traceability to customer outcomes and control requirements.


**Transformation Delivery \& Governance**
* Identify automation opportunities across journeys leveraging RPA, and AI/ML models
* Support the delivery of transformation initiatives, including business case development, benefit tracking, and stakeholder reporting.
* Ensure alignment with BUK’s transformation governance, including floorwalk showcases.


**To be successful as a "** 
**Senior Analyst \- Customer Journey Mapping" you should have experience with:**
**Essential Skills And Experience**
* Experience in Target Operating Model design and customer\-centric transformation delivery in Banking and financial services / Consulting / Global capability centers.
* Tooling: Expert level proficiency in Figma (UI/UX design), Blueworks Live (process mapping) and MS Power point (presentation and storytelling)
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable, and digitally enabled journeys.
* Drive high\-impact process optimization engagements that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and risk management.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate into actionable insights.
* Strong problem\-solving skills to identify pain points in the customer journey.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across global and cross\-functional teams.


**Preferred Skills**
- Prior experience of working in / with:

* agile transformation environments
* Customer Experience / product teams
* Familiarity with Design thinking concepts.
* Familiarity with automation and AI technologies (e.g. RPA \- UiPath / Celonis / BluePrism / Automation Anywhere, Salesforce \& Agentforce, CoPilot Studio, Amazon Bedrock GenAI).


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role will be based out of Noida/Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance \& optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance \& optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance \& optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Consultant – Spatial Ecologist
description:
**Job Description**
 Support the delivery of geospatial ecology services, including GIS, spatial data management, spatial modelling, and digital visualisation, to assist the Ecology and Environmental Approvals teams. Experience with Australian biodiversity mapping requirements is strongly favoured. The role contributes to the production of high\-quality geospatial outputs for national projects across the mining, energy, transport, and water sectors, applying spatial analysis and best practice techniques to support environmental impact assessments, regulatory approvals, and planning projects.
   

  

 Working closely with ecology and environmental approvals specialists, this role translates project requirements into effective spatial solutions, while maintaining data quality, consistency, and efficient workflows. The role also contributes to continuous improvement and innovation in geospatial processes, supporting the growth of geospatial ecology capability through strong technical delivery and collaboration across national teams and the broader WSP network.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Deliver geospatial ecology services, including GIS analysis, spatial data management, spatial modelling, and digital visualisation to support ecology and environmental approvals projects.
* Contribute to national projects across the mining, energy, transport, and water sectors, ensuring high\-quality and consistent spatial outputs.
* Apply established spatial analysis methods and support the development of best practice approaches in environmental assessment and planning.
* Collaborate with ecology and environmental approvals teams to understand project requirements and develop effective spatial solutions.
* Prepare, manage, and maintain spatial datasets, ensuring data quality, accuracy, and compliance with project and organisational standards.
* Support client deliverables, including mapping, spatial analysis, and reporting, with a focus on clear communication of spatial information.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of geospatial workflows, tools, and processes.
* Work collaboratively with national teams and the broader WSP network to support integrated project delivery.


**Qualifications**
* — Bachelor’s degree in Geospatial Science, Environmental Science, Ecology, Geography, GIS, or a related discipline. — Demonstrated experience (or early career experience) in GIS, spatial analysis, spatial data management, and/or environmental modelling. — Working knowledge of geospatial tools and platforms (e.g. ArcGIS, QGIS), with a willingness to develop advanced technical skills. — Professional membership with a relevant body (e.g. Spatial Sciences Institute (SSI), Ecological Society of Australia (ESA), or EIANZ) or willingness to work towards membership (desirable).
* Experience, skills and organisational knowledge — 5–8 years’ experience in geospatial, environmental, or related disciplines (flexible depending on level). — Experience in a consulting or project\-based environment supporting multidisciplinary work (desirable). — Experience contributing to technical project delivery, including GIS analysis, mapping, and spatial data management. — Developing capability in client\-facing interactions and communicating spatial information clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. — Strong working knowledge of spatial platforms and tools (e.g. ArcGIS, QGIS), with some exposure to Python/R or digital visualisation tools (desirable). — Experience or exposure to supporting ecology and environmental approvals projects, ideally within sectors such as mining, energy, transport, or water. — Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high\-quality outputs within agreed timeframes and budgets. — Experience with Australian or Commonwealth environmental projects.
* Personal Attributes — Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within and across multidisciplinary teams. — Demonstrates self\-awareness and a willingness to learn, adapt, and incorporate feedback. — Flexible and adaptable, able to respond to changing project requirements and priorities. — Committed to delivering high\-quality work, balancing technical accuracy with efficient delivery to timelines and budgets. — Professional and reliable, with the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues and clients.


 BGV:
   

  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third\-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.


**About Us**

 The resource will work closely with different Business Units to understand their offerings, audiences, markets, priorities, and growth objectives, and translate those business goals into structured

 The role will also provide governance across the discoverability operating model, track Business Unit\-level performance, identify growth opportunities and gaps, and translate organic and AI visibility outcomes into clear, business\-oriented insights for Marketing and leadership stakeholders.

* The
 **Organic and AI Discoverability**

 .

title: NetReveal Technical Lead
description:
**Req ID:** 
 386632
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a NetReveal Technical Lead to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 NetReveal Technical Lead
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced NetReveal Technical Lead to lead the technical implementation of a high\-volume Transaction Monitoring migration.
   

  

 The role will own the NetReveal technical workstream, including historical data loading, profile generation, scenario execution, batch optimisation and technical readiness. The successful candidate will provide hands\-on leadership to the development team and work closely with Product Owner, Data, Financial Crime, Testing, Architecture and Governance stakeholders.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead the end\-to\-end NetReveal technical workstream including interlocks with wider migration programme.
   

  

 Assess the existing NetReveal implementation, processing model, batch schedules and technical constraints.
   

  

 Define the technical approach for loading historical customer, account and transaction data.
   

  

 Design an efficient approach for loading data at scale and reduce the existing method from 20 to 30 days to 5 or 10 days.
   

  

 Define the strategy for customer profile creation, rebuild and reprofiling.
   

  

 Ensure sufficient transaction history is available to support scenario look\-back periods.
   

  

 Evaluate alternative approaches to historical transaction and sequential batch processing.
   

  

 Lead the technical implementation of customer segmentation requirements.
   

  

 Agree the design and lead implementation of a process for customer matching and merging between TSB and Santander records.
   

  

 Assess the impact of the migration on existing NetReveal scenarios, profiles and processing windows.
   

  

 Lead performance tuning, batch optimisation and technical problem resolution.
   

  

 Provide technical direction to NetReveal developers.
   

  

 Review technical designs, code, configuration and deployment artefacts.
   

  

 Work with the Test Lead to define technically representative test scenarios.
   

  

 Agree data controls and certification approach.
   

  

 Produce technical documentation and evidence for design, risk and governance approval.
   

  

 Support cutover planning, implementation, reconciliation and post\-migration assurance.
   

  

**Essential Experience**
 Extensive hands\-on experience implementing or enhancing SymphonyAI NetReveal version 8 or later (version 9 preferred).
   

  

 Strong experience with the Transaction Monitoring SMBD engine using Spark; experience limited to the classic NetReveal TM engine will not be sufficient.
   

  

 Strong understanding of NetReveal data structures, profiling, segmentation, scenarios and batch processing.
   

  

 Experience with customer profile generation, large\-scale reprofiling and migration using the TM SMBD Spark engine.
   

  

 Experience loading significant volumes of historical transaction data into NetReveal.
   

  

 Experience using and analysing Parquet files generated by the TM SMBD Spark engine for profile validation and migration activities.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AML Transaction Monitoring concepts.
   

  

 Experience with scenario look\-back periods, behavioural monitoring and customer segmentation.
   

  

 Strong SQL and data analysis capability.
   

  

 Experience diagnosing performance issues and optimising batch processing.
   

  

 Experience working within a highly governed banking environment.
   

  

 Ability to lead technical delivery while remaining sufficiently hands\-on.

**Job Title:**

**Description:** 
 In this role, You'll Drive transformation across Rights \& Royalties operations by leveraging business analysis, data analytics, and workflow automation to improve accuracy, efficiency, controls, and decision\-making. This role blends business analysis, analytics, and workflow automation to improve royalty accuracy, cycle times, controls, and decision visibility. The ideal candidate is fast, agile, and execution\-focused, able to grasp business fundamentals quickly, translate them into data and process requirements, and deliver measurable operational outcomes through dashboards, automation, and standardisation.  ● Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills.
 



 ● Team Collaboration.
 



 ● Ownership \& Accountability.
 



  





 Required Qualifications \& Experience
 



 ● Bachelor’s degree is mandatory.

 database management, or a similar role.
 



 ● Proven experience in data mining, lead generation, or a similar research role,
 



 preferably in the BFSI industry.
 



 ● Strong knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, and database management.
 



 ● Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
 



 ● Strong verbal and written communication skills.
 



 ● Ability to collect and validate data manually when required.
 



 ● Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and priorities effectively.
 



  





 Preferred / Good to Have
 



 ● Experience in FinTech, NBFC, BFSI, or a related industry.
 



 ● Experience working in a growing technology organization.
 



 ● Prior experience with data research, lead generation, email campaign operations, or
 



 database management.
 



 ● Knowledge of relevant data research, prospecting, and campaign tools.
 



 ● Basic knowledge of Python or Google Apps Script for data\-related automation.
 



  





 Key Performance Areas
 



 ● Achievement of assigned daily and weekly data mining targets.
 



 ● Quality, accuracy, completeness, and relevance of collected data.
 



 ● Timely completion of assigned data research, validation, and enrichment activities.
 



 ● Quality and accuracy of company and contact databases.
 



 ● Effective support for lead generation and email campaign requirements.
 



 ● Adherence to defined SOPs, data quality standards, and processes.
 



 ● Effective coordination with internal teams and stakeholders.
 



 ● Continuous improvement in data mining productivity, quality, and processes.

 Why Join BeFiSc?
 



 ● Build and work on high\-impact, data\-driven products used by financial

 As an SAP IBP Inventory Optimization Specialist, you will play a crucial role in driving the success of our SAP Planning \- Delivery department. Your expertise will be instrumental in optimizing inventory planning, safety stock management, and service level planning for our clients. You will work closely with our team to ensure seamless integration with SAP S/4HANA or ECC, providing efficient and effective inventory optimization solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage SAP IBP Inventory Optimization projects, ensuring timely delivery and client satisfaction.
* Conduct in\-depth analysis of client's inventory planning requirements and develop tailored solutions.
* Implement and configure SAP IBP Inventory modules, including safety stock optimization and service level planning.
* Integrate SAP IBP Inventory with SAP S/4HANA or ECC, ensuring data accuracy and seamless data flow.
* Provide ongoing support and maintenance for SAP IBP Inventory solutions, addressing any issues or enhancements.
* Train and mentor junior team members on SAP IBP Inventory best practices and functionalities.
* Stay updated with the latest SAP IBP Inventory features and industry trends, contributing to the continuous improvement of our services.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment and successful implementation of inventory optimization strategies.
* Prepare and present comprehensive reports and recommendations to clients, demonstrating the impact of inventory optimization initiatives.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in SAP IBP Inventory Optimization consulting or a related field.
* Proven track record in implementing SAP IBP Inventory solutions, with a focus on inventory planning and optimization.
* In\-depth knowledge of SAP IBP Inventory modules, including safety stock management and service level planning.
* Experience in integrating SAP IBP Inventory with SAP S/4HANA or ECC is highly preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex inventory data.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact with clients and stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency in SAP consulting methodologies and best practices.
* Willingness to continuously learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.


**About Us**
**ABOUT US**
 Bristlecone is the leading provider of AI\-powered application transformation services for the connected supply chain. We empower our customers with speed, visibility, automation, and resiliency – to thrive on change.
   

  

 Our transformative solutions in Digital Logistics, Cognitive Manufacturing, Autonomous Planning, Smart Procurement and Digitalization are positioned around key industry pillars and delivered through a comprehensive portfolio of services spanning digital strategy, design and build, and implementation across a range of technology platforms.
   

  

 Bristlecone is ranked among the top ten leaders in supply chain services by Gartner. We are headquartered in San Jose, California, with locations across North America, Europe and Asia, and over 2,500 consultants. Bristlecone is part of the $19\.4 billion Mahindra Group.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Bristlecone is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status .

* Understand and adhere to Information Security policies, guidelines and procedure, practice them for protection of organizational data and Information System.

title: Product Management Intern
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Product Management Intern to join our Product Management team. The intern will support product research, documentation, analysis, testing, and coordination activities while learning how data\-driven financial technology products are built and improved.
 



 The ideal candidate should be curious, structured, detail\-oriented, and willing to learn. This role is suitable for someone at the early stage of their career who wants practical exposure to product management, financial data intelligence, APIs, and risk technology.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 Assist in market, competitor, and customer research for new and existing product initiatives.
 



 Support the product team in understanding user problems, business requirements, and product use cases.
 



 Help prepare product documentation such as PRDs, user stories, workflow notes, feature briefs, and release notes.
 



 Coordinate with Engineering, Design, Sales, Operations, and Customer Success teams to clarify requirements and track progress.
 



 Support product testing, UAT, feedback collection, issue tracking, and release readiness activities.
 



 Analyze basic product usage data, customer feedback, and operational inputs to identify improvement areas.
 



 Maintain organized documentation and status updates for assigned product tasks.
 



 Contribute to process improvement by suggesting clearer documentation, better workflows, and structured ways of tracking product work.
 



**Required Skills** 




 Strong interest in Product Management, FinTech, financial services, data products, or technology platforms.
 



 Good analytical and structured problem\-solving abilities.
 



 Ability to write clearly and prepare structured documentation.
 



 Basic understanding of product workflows, user journeys, and requirement gathering.
 



 Comfort with Excel, Google Sheets, PowerPoint, Google Slides, or similar productivity tools.
 



 Good communication and interpersonal skills.
 



 Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
 



 Ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
 



**Required Qualifications and Experience** 




 Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, Economics, Finance, Computer Applications, or a related field.
 



 0 to 1 year of relevant experience, including internships, academic projects, startup experience, or product\-related exposure.
 



 Interest in product management, business analysis, financial technology, APIs, data analytics, or digital lending.
 



 Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
 



 Strong verbal and written communication skills.
 



 Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively.
 



 Ability to manage multiple tasks, timelines, and priorities effectively.
 



**Preferred or Good to Have** 




 Exposure to FinTech, BFSI, Insurance, Digital Lending, Digital Commerce, SaaS, or technology products.
 



 Basic understanding of APIs, data analytics, dashboards, or product documentation.
 



 Experience working on college projects, internships, case competitions, startup initiatives, or product research.
 



 Knowledge of tools such as Jira, Notion, Figma, Miro, Postman, SQL, Excel, or BI tools.
 



 Relevant certifications or additional learning in Product Management, Business Analysis, Data Analytics, Finance, or Technology.
 



 Experience working with cross\-functional teams or coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

title: Junior Business Analyst
description:
**Company Description** 




 Appvanta is an AI\-first product engineering and consulting firm founded in 2026, focused on helping startups, enterprises, and growing organizations build and modernize digital products. The company combines AI, automation, product strategy, UI/UX, and engineering to create solutions that improve customer and business experiences. Appvanta partners with clients to optimize operations, streamline processes, and drive innovation through technology. Team members work on forward\-looking projects that use AI and modern product practices to solve real\-world business challenges.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This full\-time remote Junior Business Analyst role involves supporting product and consulting projects by gathering, documenting, and analyzing business requirements. The Junior Business Analyst will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand client objectives, map current business processes, and identify opportunities for improvement. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting research, assisting in data analysis, preparing reports and presentations, and helping translate business needs into actionable recommendations. The role also entails participating in client meetings, maintaining clear communication with stakeholders, and contributing to the continuous enhancement of internal tools and practices.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong Analytical Skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support decision\-making.
* Business Analysis and Business Requirements skills to document needs, define use cases, and support solution design.
* Business Process understanding to map workflows, identify inefficiencies, and recommend improvements.
* Communication skills to present findings clearly, collaborate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and contribute in meetings.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Comfort working in a remote, technology\-driven environment and collaborating across time zones.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven or digital product environments, and basic knowledge of productivity or project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, or similar) is beneficial.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, learn quickly, and adapt to changing project needs.

title: Risk Analytics - Product Analyst - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \- Delivery Excellence Senior position**
 Within last decade, cost of delivery and Delivery excellence has become the most critical factors to run successful and popular businesses spread around the globe. To support such a dynamic and fast paced IT transformation industry, we are using various cutting\-edge Delivery Excellence models and tools with relentless focus on automation to offer best in class and tailor\-made solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As a part of our global team you will be part of GDS projects as Delivery Excellence management professional. You will be involved in working on challenging problems and creating next generation delivery excellence platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Are you a detail‑driven professional with a passion for translating business needs into impactful product experiences? Do you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Product team and help shape solutions that deliver real value to our clients and users.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll serve as a critical bridge between the business stakeholders and the development and engineering teams. Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast‑paced, evolving environment.
   

  

 As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands‑on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.
   

  

 This is a client‑facing and user‑centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real‑world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product‑focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end‑to‑end, collaborate with cross‑functional teams, and help bring scalable, user‑friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.
* Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the defined test cases, validating functionality, and ensuring readiness for release.
* Supervise in iterative testing cycles, identifying defects, documenting issues, validating fixes, and performing regression testing as needed.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Serve as one of the primary liason between business teams and engineering, providing clarifications, resolving requirement gaps, and ensuring shared understanding throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
* Engage with clients and end‑users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post‑release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Lead product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified across applications and infrastructure.
* Control Monitoring / Testing \- Understanding of controls around Business processes, ITGC, Cyber, Data protection and privacy to perform testing of design and operational effectiveness of controls.
* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Strong business\-side understanding of Risk domains relevant to building, deploying, and scaling AI‑enabled Risk products (e.g., Financial Risk, Regulatory \& Compliance, Internal Controls, Fraud, Enterprise Risk).
* Ability to translate business risk problems into product requirements and work closely with technology, data and engineering teams.
* Experience in Presales, Sales Enablement, Tech Sales, or Solution Consulting for Risk, Finance, or AI/Analytics offerings.
* Ability to support client conversations, proposal development, solution positioning, and value articulation for Risk products.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall 7\-9 years of experience in Risk Advisory (preferably Internal Controls) experience with Big 4 or comparable professional services environment
* CA or Master’s degree in business administration or Risk Management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI
* Product Management experience with demonstrated ownership of delivering business solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Field Quality Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
* Execute SQL queries to extract, clean, and analyze field performance metrics, repair data, and telemetry logs; identify and flag data anomalies for quality assessment.
* Perform end\-to\-end Failure Analysis (FA) on physical hardware samples, including board\-level debug and component diagnostics, and document findings in issue\-tracking databases.
* Conduct on\-site technical audits at repair centers and manufacturing partners, including inventory checks, root\-cause data collection, and physical hardware verification to validate repair procedures.
* Prepare detailed technical reports based on failure\-analysis investigations and data analysis, providing clear diagnostic evidence to support engineering decisions.
* Monitor bug trackers and quality databases to follow investigation progress, identify technical bottlenecks, and escalate issues based on data trends.
* Prepare regular standardized field\-quality reports using established templates and communicate key findings to relevant cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Key Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience.
* 0 \- 4 years of relevant experience in field quality, hardware failure analysis, repair engineering, manufacturing quality, or related technical areas.
* Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, cleaning, and analysis.
* Familiarity with board\-level diagnostic tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and failure\-analysis software.
* Practical experience applying 5\-Why analysis, Fishbone diagrams, or similar root\-cause identification methods in a hardware environment.
* Ability to troubleshoot hardware issues and derive data\-backed insights with limited guidance.
* Ability to travel approximately 30–50% to service centers and manufacturing sites to conduct independent diagnostic and audit work.
* Good written and spoken English.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in high\-volume consumer electronics manufacturing, connected\-device repair, service operations, or factory production environments.
* Hands\-on exposure to repair\-center audits, manufacturing\-site audits, or field\-quality investigations.
* Experience working with technical issue\-tracking systems, quality databases, or standardized reporting tools.
* Professional fluency in spoken and written Hindi and English to support local vendor communication, site activities, and regional cross\-functional collaboration.

title: Analytics Lead
description:
**Company Description** 




 Zenon is a boutique firm focused on financial services, healthcare, and private equity. We are deeply experienced in these industries, and provide analytics, data, and intelligent solutions to our clients.
 



 Our team includes some of the world’s most accomplished data scientists along with solutions architects, industry experts, and execution teams who know how to bring AI and machine learning into front line decision\-making and ongoing operations.
 



**About the Role** 




 Zenon Analytics is looking for an Analytics Lead / Manager (5–8 years of experience) to own end\-to\-end analytics and AI/ML engagements for our clients. This is a hands\-on leadership role: you will structure ambiguous business problems, build and productionize ML/AI solutions, and guide a small team of analysts through delivery — while staying close enough to the data and code to unblock them when needed.
 



 We’re looking for a mix of skills that leans more toward Analytics and Machine Learning, with working exposure to Data Engineering and enough Software Engineering (full\-stack, Python) to be a credible partner to engineering teams during deployment. You don’t need to be deep in all four — but you should be genuinely comfortable moving between them.
 



**What You Will Do** 




 •  Lead the design and development of statistical, ML, and AI\-driven solutions (including LLM\-based and agentic workflows) for a range of business problems.
 



 • Guide the team on exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model development, validation, and deployment — reviewing approach and code, not just output.
 



 • Partner with data engineering (or own it directly, where needed) to build and maintain the pipelines, data models, and infrastructure that feed analytics and ML solutions.
 



 • Work with software/product engineering teams to get models and analytical tools into production — comfortable enough with full\-stack and Python\-based development to prototype APIs, internal tools, or lightweight applications independently.
 



 • Mentor and upskill junior analysts and data scientists; review their work and set the technical bar for the team.
 



 • Contribute to business development — shaping proposals, scoping new engagements, and estimating effort.
 



 • Be comfortable with ambiguity, and enjoy structuring solutions for messy, large\-scale (Big Data) problems where the “right” approach isn’t obvious upfront.
 



**What We’re Looking For** 




***Must Have***




 • 5\-8 years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related field, with at least some experience leading projects or mentoring junior team members.
 



 • Strong hands\-on skills in Python and SQL; comfortable working across the analytics stack, not just in notebooks.
 



 • Proven experience with end\-to\-end ML model development — problem framing, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, validation, and deployment — with solid working knowledge of algorithms such as Random Forest, XGBoost, and SVM.
 



 • Familiarity with MLOps practices — model monitoring, versioning, and CI/CD for ML — and experience taking models from prototype to production.
 



 • Practical, hands\-on experience with AI/LLMs — working with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic or open\-source alternatives, including prompt engineering (zero\-shot, few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought) and building LLM\-powered features or workflows.
 



 • Working knowledge of data engineering fundamentals — building and maintaining data pipelines, writing efficient ETL/ELT, and working with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure) and tools such as Airflow or Spark.
 



 • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills — able to translate technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for business audiences.
 



***Good to Have***




 •     Prior experience with NLP on unstructured or semi\-structured data, and familiarity with Hugging Face / Transformers for accessing and deploying pre\-trained models.
 



 •     Exposure to modern front\-end frameworks (React or similar) for building internal analytics tools or dashboards.
 



 •     Prior experience in financial services or other regulated industries, or on similarly data\-intensive analytics engagements.
 



**Educational Qualification** 




 •     Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 institute; management degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
Job Title: E\-commerce \& Performance Marketing Manager
 
**Company:** 
 Carpediem Healthcare Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Industry:** 
 Nutraceuticals \& Wellness
 



**Location:** 
 Noida
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 


 About the Role
 
 Carpediem Healthcare is looking for an experienced
 **E\-commerce \& Performance Marketing Manager** 
 to lead and grow our online business across
 **India and international markets** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should have proven experience working with a
 **nutraceutical, healthcare, wellness, or supplement brand** 
 , with strong knowledge of e\-commerce operations, marketplace management, Shopify, performance marketing, and customer acquisition.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Develop and execute the complete e\-commerce growth strategy for domestic and international markets.
* Manage the company’s D2C website, including Shopify operations, product listings, pricing, offers, inventory coordination, checkout performance, and conversion\-rate optimization.
* Manage online marketplaces such as Amazon India, Amazon Global, Flipkart, and other relevant domestic and international platforms.
* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across
 **Meta Ads and Google Ads** 
 .
* Monitor ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rate, AOV, repeat purchases, and overall campaign profitability.
* Create campaign strategies for product launches, retargeting, customer acquisition, and remarketing.
* Coordinate with creative, content, product, logistics, and customer\-support teams.
* Plan promotional calendars, offers, bundles, subscriptions, and marketplace campaigns.
* Conduct competitor research, market analysis, pricing comparison, and customer\-behaviour analysis.
* Manage product feeds, Merchant Center, pixels, conversion APIs, analytics, and campaign tracking.
* Identify opportunities for international expansion and manage cross\-border e\-commerce operations.
* Ensure that product content and advertisements comply with applicable nutraceutical, marketplace, and advertising guidelines.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering sales, advertising performance, profitability, inventory, and growth opportunities.
* Take complete ownership of online revenue growth and marketplace performance.


 Required Experience and Skills
 * Minimum
 **4–7 years of relevant experience** 
 in e\-commerce and performance marketing.
* Previous experience with a
 **nutraceutical, dietary supplement, healthcare, wellness, or FMCG brand** 
 is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing both domestic and international e\-commerce markets.
* Strong working knowledge of Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub, and cross\-border marketplaces.
* Hands\-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Merchant Center, GA4, and conversion tracking.
* Strong understanding of marketplace SEO, keyword research, A\+ Content, listing optimization, and account health.
* Ability to manage advertising budgets and scale campaigns profitably.
* Good understanding of funnels, landing pages, customer retention, email marketing, and WhatsApp marketing.
* Strong analytical, communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple channels, and take complete ownership of results.


 Preferred Qualifications
 * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, E\-commerce, or a related field.
* Experience launching or scaling a nutraceutical brand in India and international markets.
* Knowledge of FSSAI\-related communication restrictions and international supplement advertising requirements.
* Experience managing marketplaces in regions such as the USA, UK, UAE, Australia, Central Asia, or Southeast Asia will be an advantage.


 What We Are Looking For
 
 We need a result\-oriented professional who understands that e\-commerce management goes beyond running advertisements. The selected candidate should be capable of managing the complete online business—from marketplace operations and website conversion to customer acquisition, retention, analytics, and profitable revenue growth.
 


 Compensation
 
 Competitive salary based on experience, expertise, and proven performance.
 



 Interested candidates may share their CV along with details of the brands, marketplaces, advertising budgets, and revenue growth they have previously managed.
